_readme: The whole musical arc of a fight, in the running game: the road's theme, displaced by
the fight's, stung by the win, handed back to the room, and re-stated on the way out.
A script of its own rather than steps added to the_game_makes_noise, for the reason that
one's readme gives: Qa runs one step per physics frame, so inserting anywhere shifts
every later frame in the file.
Two kinds of assertion here, and the difference is the point. Without 'now' it reads the
REQUEST LOG - what was asked for since the last sound_mark - which is how a tune that
played and finished is still provable. With 'now' it reads what is playing THIS FRAME,
which is the only way to say silence, and the only way to prove the fanfare handed the
room back rather than simply ending.
The wait after the win is the fanfare's own length with slack: triumph is two bars at
140bpm, about 3.4 seconds, so 240 frames is comfortably past it. Over-waiting is safe
here - what is being proven is that the hand-back HAPPENED, and it does not un-happen.

steps.text: the warden opens the game - hear her out first
the village names the road's theme, and it is what is playing before anything else happens
west into the hollow, into the thing standing in the gap
the fight takes the room over - asked for, and playing right now
see it through. press_until_state mashes, so every press is mistimed and the fight is won the slow way - which is fine, this script is about what it sounds like

and hands the room back. The hollow states NO music, so what it hands back to is that map's own silence - which the request log could never have shown, because a tune that played and stopped is in it either way
and back east onto the road, which states its theme again
